sections.content:
Another no-impact action. I'm wasting too many actions trying to figure out this mechanic. Let me step back and think about this differently.
Looking at all the successful moves:
1. (12, 24) - initial magenta center - 36 cells changed, diamond moved
2. (14, 27) - magenta center - 20 cells changed, diamond moved right
3. (13, 30) - path cell - 20 cells changed, diamond moved right
4. (13, 33) - path cell - 20 cells changed, diamond moved right
5. (14, 30) - magenta center - 36 cells changed, diamond moved LEFT
Failed moves (1 cell changed):
- (14, 28) - inside diamond
- (12, 34) - path cell
- (13, 34) - path cell
- (13, 31) - inside diamond
- (13, 32) - path cell
The successful moves all changed 20+ cells. The failed ones only changed 1 cell. 
Let me think about what's different. The successful path clicks (13, 30) and (13, 33) were on cells that became part of the diamond after the move. The failed path clicks (12, 34), (13, 34), (13, 32) were on cells that didn't become part of the diamond.
Wait, maybe the rule is: clicking a path cell adjacent to the diamond moves the diamond INTO that cell, but only if that cell is on the correct path direction. The diamond can only move along the path, and the path has a specific direction.
Looking at the path layout:
- The path seems to go from the ring (top-right) toward the bottom-left, or vice versa.
- When I clicked (13, 30) and (13, 33), the diamond moved right (toward the ring).
- When I clicked the magenta center (14, 30), the diamond moved left (away from the ring).
Maybe the diamond can only move in one direction along the path, and clicking the magenta center reverses the direction? Or maybe clicking the magenta center moves it in the opposite direction?
Actually, wait. Let me reconsider. After the magenta click moved the diamond LEFT, the path configuration changed. The path cells that were previously adjacent to the diamond's right edge are no longer in the same position relative to the diamond.
Let me look at the current state more carefully. The diamond is at cols 27-31. The path to the right is at cols 32-34 on row 13. But clicking (13, 32) didn't work. 
Hmm, maybe the issue is that the diamond moved left and is now "facing" left, so it can only move left further. Let me try clicking the path to the left of the diamond.
Looking at the ascii:
Row 15: `BBBwwOOOOOBBBBBBBBBB` - path at cols 25-26 (ww), diamond at 27-31
Row 16: `wwwBBBOOOBBBBBBBBBBB` - path at cols 22-24 (www)
Let me try clicking (15, 26) which is the path cell adjacent to the diamond's left edge.
